# ADDitude Magazine

> > ADDitude Magazine is a comprehensive digital resource for ADHD and learning disability information, community support, and professional services directory.

ADDitude Magazine provides evidence-based articles, webinars, and expert guidance on ADHD and ADD management. The site maintains a professional directory connecting individuals with ADHD coaches, therapists, and service providers.

## Key Topics

- ADHD
- ADD
- Learning Disabilities
- ADDitude Directory
- ADHD Resources
- ADDitude Magazine
- Body Image
- Mother-Daughter Relationships
- Service Listings
- Business Directory
- Expert Guidance
- Webinars
- Professional Coaching
- Therapy Services
- Mental Health

## Professional Directory & Advertising

- [ADHD Product and Services Directory: List Your Business](https://directory.additudemag.com/advertise.php): Advertising and listing page for ADHD coaches, therapists, and service providers to showcase their business in ADDitude's professional directory

## Educational Webinars

- [Mother-Daughter Relationships: Impact on Body Image, Weight Bias, Eating](https://www.additudemag.com/webinar/mother-daughter-relationships-body-image): Expert webinar with Dr. Sophie Whynacht exploring the connection between mother-daughter relationships and body image concerns in the context of ADHD

## User Account & Support

- [Log In — ADDitude Magazine](https://www.additudemag.com/wp-login.php): WordPress authentication portal for ADDitude Magazine subscribers and registered users to access account features
